review_rules.title: Use active voice
review_rules.description: Sentences should use active voice (subject performs action) rather than passive voice
review_rules.example_violation: The API is called by the client.
review_rules.example_fixed: The client calls the API.

review_rules.title: Avoid contractions in formal documentation
review_rules.description: Formal technical documentation should not use contractions like don't, can't, it's
review_rules.example_violation: You can't modify the config after it's been deployed.
review_rules.example_fixed: You cannot modify the configuration after it has been deployed.

review_rules.title: Consistent punctuation in lists
review_rules.description: List items should consistently end with or without periods
review_rules.example_violation:
1. Start the server
2. Open the dashboard.
review_rules.example_fixed:
1. Start the server
2. Open the dashboard

review_rules.title: Proper heading hierarchy
review_rules.description: Document should have single H1, with H2-H3 in proper order (no skipping levels)
review_rules.example_violation:
H1: Topic
H3: Subtopic (missing H2)
review_rules.example_fixed:
H1: Topic
H2: Section
H3: Subtopic

review_rules.title: Concept topics should follow standard section order
review_rules.description: Concept docs should order sections: Overview, Purpose, Key Concepts, When to Use, Related Topics
review_rules.example_violation: Overview, Related Topics, Purpose, Key Concepts
review_rules.example_fixed: Overview, Purpose, Key Concepts, When to Use, Related Topics

review_rules.title: Task topics must have Prerequisites section
review_rules.description: Procedural tasks should clearly list prerequisites before step instructions
review_rules.example_violation: Steps: 1. Install...
review_rules.example_fixed:
Prerequisites: You must have admin access
Steps: 1. Install...

review_rules.title: Define acronyms on first use
review_rules.description: Acronyms and abbreviations should be spelled out with acronym in parentheses on first use
review_rules.example_violation: Configure the API endpoint.
review_rules.example_fixed: Configure the Application Programming Interface (API) endpoint.

review_rules.title: Consistent terminology
review_rules.description: Use the same term consistently throughout the document (e.g., always 'configuration' not 'config' and 'configuration')
review_rules.example_violation: First use: API. Later: Application Programming Interface.
review_rules.example_fixed: Consistent use of 'API' or spell out each time

review_rules.title: Keep sentences under 25 words
review_rules.description: Long sentences reduce readability; aim for clear, concise sentences
review_rules.example_violation: The system processes incoming requests and validates them against the configured rules to ensure that they meet all the required criteria before they are forwarded to the next processing step.
review_rules.example_fixed: The system validates incoming requests against configured rules. It then forwards approved requests to the next step.

review_rules.title: Keep paragraphs under 5 sentences
review_rules.description: Short paragraphs are easier to scan and read
review_rules.example_violation: Long paragraph with 8+ sentences
review_rules.example_fixed: Paragraphs of 3-4 sentences maximum

review_rules.title: Explain or define technical jargon
review_rules.description: Technical terms should be defined, especially for audience with varying expertise
review_rules.example_violation: Configure the OAuth2 token endpoint.
review_rules.example_fixed: Configure the OAuth2 token endpoint (the server that issues authentication tokens).

review_rules.title: Concept topics must include all required sections
review_rules.description: Required: Title, Introduction, Purpose, Key Concepts, When to Use, Related Topics
review_rules.example_violation: Missing 'When to Use' section
review_rules.example_fixed: All required sections present

review_rules.title: Include examples or code samples
review_rules.description: Technical documentation should include practical examples where applicable
review_rules.example_violation: Explain how to use the API without example code
review_rules.example_fixed: Explain with example code block showing usage

review_rules.title: All parameters must be documented
review_rules.description: Reference topics must document all properties/parameters with type, description, and constraints
review_rules.example_violation: Parameter 'timeout' listed but no description
review_rules.example_fixed: timeout (number): Request timeout in milliseconds. Default: 5000. Min: 0.

review_rules.title: Code blocks should have language markers
review_rules.description: Code samples should be marked with language (json, python, javascript, etc.)

review_rules.title: Proper list formatting
review_rules.description: Lists should have consistent indentation, punctuation, and use appropriate list type (ordered vs unordered)
review_rules.example_violation: Inconsistently formatted lists with mixed punctuation
review_rules.example_fixed: All list items consistently formatted

review_rules.title: Descriptive hyperlink text
review_rules.description: Links should have descriptive text, not 'click here' or generic terms
review_rules.example_violation: [click here](url)
review_rules.example_fixed: [API Reference Documentation](url)

review_rules.title: Images must have alt text
review_rules.description: All images should include descriptive alt text for screen readers

review_rules.title: Sufficient color contrast
review_rules.description: Text should have sufficient contrast ratio (4.5:1 for normal text)
review_rules.example_violation: Light gray text on white background
review_rules.example_fixed: Dark text on white or white text on dark background

review_rules.title: Maintain consistent tone
review_rules.description: Documentation should maintain consistent tone (formal, conversational, etc.) throughout
review_rules.example_violation: Mix of very formal and very casual language
review_rules.example_fixed: Consistently professional tone throughout

review_rules.title: Use second person for task docs
review_rules.description: Task and procedural documentation should address reader as 'you'
review_rules.example_violation: The user should click the button.
review_rules.example_fixed: Click the button.

critical.description: Must fix - prevents documentation from meeting minimum standards

warning.description: Should fix - impacts clarity or consistency

info.description: Nice to fix - minor improvements to readability or style
